adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out `blacklistedGuestEmails` (from `process.env.BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS`) without returning any information about which requested emails were excluded; it only errors when *all* requested guests are excluded (`if (uniqueGuests.length === 0) throw ...`). The client `AddGuestsDialog` always shows a generic success toast (`showToast(t("guests_added"), "success")`) on mutation success. Therefore, for a mixed list, some guests can be silently not added while the UI reports success, matching the finding.
